paite: Huan hichi ahong hi a, huai nung in David in, "Judah gam a khua khatpeuh ah ka hohtou diam?" chi in TOUPA adong hi. TOUPA'N akiang ah, "Hohtou in," achi hi. David in, "Koi ah ahia ka hohtouh ding?" achi a, Ama'n, "Hebron ah,” achi hi.
heading: Judah Kumpipa A David Bawl Ahi
english: After this, David inquired of Yahweh, saying, “Shall I go up into any of the cities of Judah?” Yahweh said to him, “Go up.” David said, “Where shall I go up?” He said, “To Hebron.”

paite: Huchi in David, azi nihte, Jezreel mi Ahinoam leh Karmel mi Nabal zi Abigail toh huai ah ahohtou hi.
english: So David went up there with his two wives, Ahinoam the Jezreelitess, and Abigail the wife of Nabal the Carmelite.

paite: David in akiang a om mi tengteng apitou a, michih a-inkuante chiat uh toh, Hebron khuate ah atengta uhi.
english: David brought up his men who were with him, every man with his household. They lived in the cities of Hebron.

paite: Judah gam a mite ahong hoh ua, huai ah Judah inkote tung a kumpipa ding in David thau anilh uhi. Huchi in "Saul vui mite Jabesh-gilead mite ahi uh," chi in David ahilh uhi.
english: The men of Judah came, and there they anointed David king over the house of Judah. They told David, “The men of Jabesh Gilead were those who buried Saul.”

paite: Jabesh-gilead mite kiang ah David in mite asawl a, akiang uah, "Na pu uh Saul na hehpihdan uh hihlang a na vui ziak un, TOUPA'N hon vualzawl hen.
english: David sent messengers to the men of Jabesh Gilead, and said to them, “Blessed are you by Yahweh, that you have shown this kindness to your lord, even to Saul, and have buried him.

paite: Tu in TOUPA'N na tung uah zahngaihna leh thutak langsak henla; hiai thil na hih ziak un ke'n leng na chit man uh ka hon thuk ding.
english: Now may Yahweh show loving kindness and truth to you. I also will reward you for this kindness, because you have done this thing.

paite: Huaiziak in tu in na khutte uh hong hat henla, hangsantak in om un. Na pu uh Saul asita hi. Judah inkote'n atung ua kumpipa ding in thau ahon nilh khinta uhi," chi in ava gensak hi.
english: Now therefore let your hands be strong, and be valiant; for Saul your lord is dead, and also the house of Judah have anointed me king over them.”

paite: Himahleh Ner tapa Abner, Saul sepaihte heutu in, Mahanaim ah Saul tapa Ishboshet apaipih hi.
heading: Israel Kumpipa A Ishboshet Bawl Ahi
english: Now Abner the son of Ner, captain of Saul’s army, had taken Ishbosheth the son of Saul and brought him over to Mahanaim.

paite: Gilead, Ashur, Jezreel, Ephraim leh Israel tengteng tung a kumpipa in abawlta hi.
english: He made him king over Gilead, over the Ashurites, over Jezreel, over Ephraim, over Benjamin, and over all Israel.

paite: Saul tapa Ishboshet in Israel tung a vaihawm apat in kum sawmli a upa ahi a, kum nih sung vai ahawm hi. Himahleh Judah mite'n David azui uh.
english: Ishbosheth, Saul’s son, was forty years old when he began to reign over Israel, and he reigned two years. But the house of Judah followed David.

paite: David in Hebron a Judah chite tung ah kum sagih leh kha guk vai ahawm hi.
english: The time that David was king in Hebron over the house of Judah was seven years and six months.

paite: Ner tapa Abner leh Saul tapa Ishboshet sikhate Mahanaim a pan apawtkhia ua, Gibeon ah apai uhi.
heading: Israel Leh Judah Kidouna
english: Abner the son of Ner, and the servants of Ishbosheth the son of Saul, went out from Mahanaim to Gibeon.

paite: Zeruiah tapa Joab leh David sikhate apaikhia ua, Gibeon dil ah akituak uhi. Pawl khat dil gal khat lam ah atu a, pawl khat pen dil gal langkhat ah atu hi.
english: Joab the son of Zeruiah and David’s servants went out, and met them by the pool of Gibeon; and they sat down, the one on the one side of the pool and the other on the other side of the pool.

paite: Abner in Joab kiang ah, "Tangvalte hong kuan uhenla, i ma uah hong kisual uhen," achi hi. Joab in, "Hong kuan le uh ake," achi hi.
english: Abner said to Joab, “Please let the young men arise and compete before us!” Joab said, “Let them arise!”

paite: Huchi in akuan ua, azah chiang sep in agalkah phei ua, Benjamin chi, Saul tapa Ishboshet lam a pang sawm-le-nih, David sikha sawm-le-nih ahi uh.
english: Then they arose and went over by number: twelve for Benjamin and for Ishbosheth the son of Saul, and twelve of David’s servants.

paite: Alangte uh lu chiat ah akimantuah ua, amau tumte chiat namsau in anak ah akidawt ua; apukkhawm vek uhi. Huaiziak in huai mun Helkath-hazzurim achi ua, huai Gibeon a om ahi.
english: They each caught his opponent by the head and thrust his sword in his fellow’s side; so they fell down together. Therefore that place in Gibeon was called Helkath Hazzurim.

paite: Huai ni a akisual uh athupi mahmah a, David sikhate ma ah Abner leh Israel mite zoh in a-om uhi,
english: The battle was very severe that day; and Abner was beaten, and the men of Israel, before David’s servants.

paite: Huai mun ah Zeruiah tapate thum, Joab, Abishai leh Asahel a-om uhi. Asahel zukpi bang a ngalhat ahi.
english: The three sons of Zeruiah were there: Joab, Abishai, and Asahel. Asahel was as light of foot as a wild gazelle.

paite: Asahel in Abner adelh a; Abner adelh taklam hiam veilam hiam a pialsan het lou in adelh vengveng hi.
english: Asahel pursued Abner. He didn’t turn to the right hand or to the left from following Abner.

paite: Abner alehngat a, "Nang na hi maw, Asahel?" achi hi. Ama'n adawng a, “Ka hi,” achi hi.
english: Then Abner looked behind him and said, “Is that you, Asahel?” He answered, “It is.”

paite: Abner in akiang ah, "Na taklam hiam, na veilam hiam ah pialkhia inla, tangval khat man inla, agalvan laksak in," achi hi. Himahleh Asahel in amah adelh apialsan nuam tuan kei hi.
english: Abner said to him, “Turn away to your right hand or to your left, and grab one of the young men, and take his armor.” But Asahel would not turn away from following him.

paite: Abner in Asahel kiang ah, "Hon pialsan in. Bangziak a lei a hon satpuk ding ka hia? Na unaupa Joab mel ka mu ngam dia hia?" achi nawn hi.
english: Abner said again to Asahel, “Turn away from following me. Why should I strike you to the ground? How then could I look Joab your brother in the face?”

paite: Himahleh apial nuam tuan kei. Huaiziak in Abner in ateipi tolam in anakguh ngana nuaitak asun a, anunglam ah teipi apaisuak a, huai mun a puk in asita hi. Huan hichi ahong hi a, Asahel puk a, asihna mun a hong pai teng huai mun ah akhawl zel uhi.
english: However, he refused to turn away. Therefore Abner with the back end of the spear struck him in the body, so that the spear came out behind him; and he fell down there and died in the same place. As many as came to the place where Asahel fell down and died stood still.

paite: Himahleh, Joab leh Abishai in Abner adelhzui ua; Gibeon gamdai lampi a Giah chin a Ammah mual atun un ni atumta hi.
english: But Joab and Abishai pursued Abner. The sun went down when they had come to the hill of Ammah, that lies before Giah by the way of the wilderness of Gibeon.

paite: Benjamin suante Abner kiang ah akikaikhawm ua, pawl khat in akibawl ua, mualvum ah ava dinghta uh.
english: The children of Benjamin gathered themselves together after Abner and became one band, and stood on the top of a hill.

paite: Abner in Joab asam a, "Namsau in hon negai den ding hia? Atawplam in ahong kha mahmah ding, chih na thei kei maw? Bang tan ahia a-unaute uh delh tawpsan a kik nawn dia mipite hilh lou a na om ding?" achi hi.
english: Then Abner called to Joab, and said, “Shall the sword devour forever? Don’t you know that it will be bitterness in the latter end? How long will it be then, before you ask the people to return from following their brothers?”

paite: Joab in, "Pathian ahin bang in ka gen ahi. Bangmah na gen lou hi lechin zingchiang a pan mite paimang khinta ding ua, a-unaute uh delh lou ding hi ve un," achi hi.
english: Joab said, “As God lives, if you had not spoken, surely then in the morning the people would have gone away, and not each followed his brother.”

paite: Joab in pengkul amut a, mite adingh depdup uh. Israel mite adelhta kei ua, kuamah asual nawnta kei uhi.
english: So Joab blew the trumpet; and all the people stood still and pursued Israel no more, and they fought no more.

paite: Abner leh amite zankhua in phaizang tawnsuak a pai in Jordan akan ua, Bithron akantan ua, Mahanaim atung uhi.
english: Abner and his men went all that night through the Arabah; and they passed over the Jordan, and went through all Bithron, and came to Mahanaim.

paite: Joab bel Abner delh akik nawnta a, mipi tengteng akaihkhawm vek leh David sikhate sawm-le-kua leh Asahel akimta kei uhi.
english: Joab returned from following Abner; and when he had gathered all the people together, nineteen men of David’s and Asahel were missing.

paite: Himahleh David sikhate'n Benjamin mite leh Abner mite zathum-le-sawmguk athat uhi.
english: But David’s servants had struck Benjamin and Abner’s men so that three hundred sixty men died.

paite: Asahel luang ala ua, Bethlehem a apa han ah avui uh. Joab leh amite zankhua in apai ua, khovak in Hebron atung uhi.
english: They took up Asahel and buried him in the tomb of his father, which was in Bethlehem. Joab and his men went all night, and the day broke on them at Hebron.
